label: Young people rise up to retaliate for what happened to Maduro
description: That this is nowhere near over and that young people will be involved, rising up to retaliate for what happened to the removed Venezuelan leader and causing turmoil.

label: Eighty warnings about Cuba, more than about anything else
description: His own count that the Lord has warned about Cuba around eighty times, which he says shocked him, and that he does not think anything else has ever been brought up that many times. A claim about the record itself rather than about the world, and one the archive can be checked against.

label: Another major attack coming to Seattle
description: A major attack seen coming to Seattle, seen all over the place and said to be shown by the Lord, given alongside the earthquake and Yellowstone material rather than as part of it.

label: White water rapids around the major banks
description: White water rapids by the banks, described as very bumpy and very turbulent all around Chase and Bank of America, with BlackRock standing by itself for Europe.

label: Rubio cracks a whip and forces a revaluation
description: A named American official coming in and cracking a whip, telling them they will revalue their money and do what they are told, described as a strong arm.

label: A shallow wave lays a thin layer of gold across America
description: A shallow wave that on reaching the ground laid a thin layer of gold across the ground of the United States, with the Lord telling him to fill his pockets.

label: Fountains of wealth come out of Zion
description: That the wealth is coming from Zion, given with the caveat that he does not want to misquote and only believes that is what was said.

label: Great corruption comes out of California
description: Great corruption coming out of California, given on the same day as a word that a level of glory is coming but a level of purification with it, because to whom much is given much is required.

label: The financial harvest will disappoint many who expect millions
description: That the coming time of blessing will also be disappointing for many, because the numbers he saw left people disappointed against their own visions of grandeur, with the warning not to be discouraged by a million dollars when the expectation was twenty or thirty million. A rare downward revision of his own wealth-transfer teaching.

label: If I do not see it, it is not there
description: His rule for separating what he will say from what he will not: if he does not see it, it is not there, it is fake, and what he passes on is only what he saw. Given alongside the admission that he is telling them what he saw driving around that day.
